Frequently asked questions
What is Liinks?Liinks turns your link in bio into a beautiful mini website. Add links, photos, videos, forms, FAQs, testimonials, and your latest Instagram posts, organize them into tabs and folders, and share it all from one link like liinks.co/yourname, or your own domain on Pro.
How long does it take to set up?About a minute to get started. Enter your Instagram handle and Liinks pulls in your photo, bio, and recent posts to build your first page. You can also start from your website or from scratch. Then make it yours with themes, fonts, and blocks, and go live whenever you're ready.
Why isn't there a free plan?Because you're the customer, not the product. Free tiers get paid for somehow, usually with ads, data, or constant upsells, and we'd rather keep your page clean and work for you. You can still build your entire page for free and take as long as you like. When you're ready to go live, every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
How much does Liinks cost?Liinks offers two plans: Starter at $5/mo with all the essentials, and Pro at $12/mo which adds custom domains and multi-profile management. Both plans include a 14-day free trial.
Can I use my own domain?Yes! With the Pro plan, you can connect a custom domain so your page lives at your own URL instead of liinks.co.
Can I manage multiple profiles?Yes. The Pro plan lets you manage multiple profiles from a single account, each with its own page. Perfect for agencies, teams, or anyone running more than one brand.
What kind of content can I add?Links, images, videos, music embeds, contact forms, text blocks, folders, social icons, and more. Liinks supports a wide variety of block types so you can showcase your work however you want.
Do I get analytics?Yes. Liinks includes built-in analytics so you can track page views, link clicks, and see where your audience is coming from.
Can I cancel anytime?Absolutely. There are no contracts or commitments. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings.
